all.name: All elements
all.text: The card has all five elements and counts as each of them.

degrade.name: Degrade
degrade.text: Move a unit down one tier. Impossible if the tier below is full or the unit is already on Tier 1. A unit degraded from Tier 4 goes to its owner's Tier 3.

develop.name: Develop
develop.text: Move one of your units up one tier into a free spot.

disrupt.name: Disrupt
disrupt.text: Look at a target opponent's hand and choose 1 card. They discard it.

eot.name: End of turn
eot.text: Takes effect in the first step of its owner's end of turn.

freeze.name: Freeze
freeze.text: Put a freeze token on the unit. It can't be developed while it has a freeze token.

invoke.name: Invoke
invoke.text: Use your class's invoke to get a value.

on_damage_taken.name: On damage taken
on_damage_taken.text: Takes effect each time this unit takes damage.

on_kill.name: On kill
on_kill.text: Takes effect when this unit's attack destroys an enemy unit.

refresh.name: Refresh
refresh.text: Remove the rightmost card of a market from the game, slide the others right and reveal a new card on the left.

scout.name: Scout
scout.text: Look at the top X cards of your deck, then put them back in the same order.

shield.name: Shield
shield.text: Put a shield token on the unit. Each shield token absorbs one whole hit.

split.name: Split
split.text: You may split the damage, in whole points, among any units the card can target.

sot.name: Start of turn
sot.text: Takes effect during its owner's start of turn.

stun.name: Stun
stun.text: Put a stun token on the unit. It can't attack while it has a stun token.

summon.name: Summon
summon.text: Create a token unit with the stats shown. It counts as a Tier 1 unit but uses no spot.
